correctness.rationale: The ordinary Leibniz extension preserves v∧v=0 and is unique; its third iterate in characteristic 3 is again a derivation and restricts to M³. For generator blocks J₁,J₂,J₃, the full exterior modules have types 2J₁, 2J₁+J₂, and 2J₁+2J₃: on ∧²J₃ a nonzero two-step chain runs e₂∧e₃ → e₁∧e₃ → e₁∧e₂. In k[x,y]/(x²,y²), (x+y)²=2xy≠0 gives J₂⊗J₂=J₃+J₁. For k[x,y]/(x³,yˢ) the substitution x=t−y makes the algebra free over k[t]/(t³), since y³=0. Quotienting the integral Green ring by the span of J₃ leaves two independent classes with u²=1; evaluating (2+u)ᵇ at ±1 recovers the two actual short-block multiplicities. Dimension gives C, and the two rank equations and n recover (a,b,c). For the finite count, Hom(Jᵢ,Jⱼ) has dimension min(i,j); reducing diagonal length groups modulo t gives the semisimple quotient. On V/tV the kernel of this reduction acts strictly triangularly by block length, so products of three members raise t-adic filtration and products of nine vanish. This proves the radical description and the unit count, with equivariance supplying the rank-stratum orbit formula. Independently, for n=4,q=3, the three nonzero types have counts 40·13·2 (image line in kernel hyperplane), 130·48 (image=kernel plane), and 40·13·12·12 (image and kernel planes meeting in the image-of-square line, and an isomorphism V/ker→im mapping the specified line to that line). Together with the zero map these reproduce 82161 and the stated rank pairs. The attached code was inspected as finite corroboration, not run or used in place of the proof.

value.rationale: Knowing n, two ranks of the induced action on the whole exterior algebra determine the generator similarity type with no grading-by-grading rank data. Projective cancellation explains this rigidity rather than just yielding a small-dimension table, and the census labels previously distinct rank strata. The claim is restricted to ordinary degree-zero derivations, cube zero and characteristic three; it does not assert minimality of the rank data or a new centralizer enumeration.
